title: Lantern and Ledger
author: Jude Montrose
blurb: Wendell Almeida, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
